questions.question_en: The Council of Ministers does not include more than 15% of the total number of members of the House of the People applies to which of the following? 1. Council of Ministers at the Centre; 2. State Councils of Ministers.
questions.topic: President, Vice-President, Prime Minister and Council of Ministers
questions.language_status: English structured extraction; Telugu not included in index
questions.explanation_en: Reworded from UPSC CSP 2022 Q14; the answer here follows this wording (option 1). Under the 91st Amendment the Union Council of Ministers may not exceed 15% of the Lok Sabha (Article 75(1A)); for States the limit is 15% of the Assembly (Article 164(1A)), not of the House of the People. So the statement applies to the Centre only (option 1). The 15% ceiling on Council of Ministers applies to both Centre and States (91st Constitutional Amendment, 2003).
questions.explanation_te: ఈ ప్రశ్న UPSC CSP 2022 Q14 నుంచి మార్చి రాసినది (reworded); ఇక్కడి జవాబు ఈ పాఠం ప్రకారమే (ఎంపిక 1). 91వ సవరణ (Amendment) ప్రకారం కేంద్ర మంత్రిమండలి లోక్‌సభ సభ్యుల సంఖ్యలో 15% మించకూడదు (ప్రకరణ (Article) 75(1A)). రాష్ట్రాల్లో ఈ పరిమితి శాసనసభ సభ్యుల సంఖ్యలో 15% (ప్రకరణ 164(1A)), లోక్‌సభది కాదు. కాబట్టి ఎంపిక 1.

can choose his cabinet colleagues after due counselling by the President of India in this regard
has full discretion in the choice of persons who are to serve as ministers in his cabinet
has only limited powers in the choice of his cabinet colleagues because of the discretionary power vested with the President of India
questions.answer_text: has full discretion in the choice of persons who are to serve as ministers in his cabinet
questions.topic: President, Vice-President, Prime Minister and Council of Ministers

questions.question_en: If the Prime Minister of India belonged to the Upper House of Parliament
options_en: he will not be able to vote in his favour in the event of a no confidence motion
he will not be able to speak on the Budget in the Lower House
he can make statements only on the Upper House
he has to become a member of the Lower House within six months after being sworn in as the Prime Minister
questions.answer_text: he will not be able to vote in his favour in the event of a no confidence motion

questions.question_en: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the office of Prime Minister?
questions.question_te: ఈ క్రింది వాటిల్లో ప్రధానమంత్రిపదవికి సంబంధించి సరైన ప్రకటన ఏది?
options_en: Constitutionally, the Prime Minister should definitely be a member of the Lok Sabha.
The term of the Prime Minister is not fixed and he holds office during the pleasure of the parliament.
The salary and allowances are determined by the President.
The death of an incumbent Prime Minister automatically dissolves the council of ministers.
options_te: రాజ్యాంగబద్ధంగా ప్ర ధానమంత్రి కచ్చితంగా లోక్‌సభ సభ్యుడు అయి ఉండాలి.

ప్ర స్తుత ప్రధాన మంత్రి యొక్క మరణం అనంతరం స్వాభావికంగా (ఆటోమాటికల్లీ) మంత్రిమండలి రద్దు అవుతుంది.
